entries.dialogueText: “We have come this far. We can handle it.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I will do my best.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I will do my best.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“If you will excuse me, I have to g..."
entries.dialogueText: “If you will excuse me, I have to get to work immediately. There is much to be done.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian packed up his bag and starte..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian packed up his bag and started making his way to the entrance.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“We might have been able to survive..."
entries.dialogueText: “We might have been able to survive if you privatized only one of the companies, but fully privatizing both of them...”

entries.speaker: Mikail Aven
entries.title: Mikail Aven: "“I want to thank you, Mr. President..."
entries.dialogueText: “I want to thank you, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Mikail Aven
entries.title: Mikail Aven: "“This decision will revitalize our..."
entries.dialogueText: “This decision will revitalize our economy. Eliminating recession completely is not so far off now.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“This will definitely show our trad..."
entries.dialogueText: “This will definitely show our trade partners that Sordland is moving in the right direction. Which in turn will increase trust... which means more income.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Yes, fully privatizing a state cor..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, fully privatizing a state corporation might give us the budgetary boost required to help us end the recession.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“Excellent decision.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Excellent decision.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I'm not so sure about that.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'm not so sure about that.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“I have to agree.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I have to agree.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“But we can only pave the way forwa..."
entries.dialogueText: “But we can only pave the way forward for Sordland if we are leading the country from the top.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Mr. President. Your decision will..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. Your decision will make us lose the support of many conservatives in the Assembly.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Thank you for heeding my suggestio..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for heeding my suggestions, sir.”

entries.speaker: Mikail Aven
entries.title: Mikail Aven: "“I want to thank you, Mr. President..."
entries.dialogueText: “I want to thank you, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Mikail Aven
entries.title: Mikail Aven: "“This decision will revitalize our..."
entries.dialogueText: “This decision will revitalize our economy.”

entries.speaker: Mikail Aven
entries.title: Mikail Aven: "“Although I wish we could have proc..."
entries.dialogueText: “Although I wish we could have proceeded with privatization in a greater capacity, it is a start.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“Certainly a step in the right dire..."
entries.dialogueText: “Certainly a step in the right direction.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Partial privatization will still d..."
entries.dialogueText: “Partial privatization will still deal damage to our conservative voter base. But it is nothing we can't handle.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I believe this was the best outcom..."
entries.dialogueText: “I believe this was the best outcome we could have hoped for.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I suspect that, regardless, we wil..."
entries.dialogueText: “I suspect that, regardless, we will lose the support of some conservatives in the Assembly.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“But the gains we receive will offs..."
entries.dialogueText: “But the gains we receive will offset the losses.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I hope you are right.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I hope you are right.”
entries.menuText: “I hope you are right.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I don't care about the conservativ..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't care about the conservatives in the Assembly.”
entries.menuText: “I don't care about the conservatives in the Assembly.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Make sure those gains happen.""
entries.dialogueText: “Make sure those gains happen."
entries.menuText: “Make sure those gains happen."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“As you wish. I will not leave any..."
entries.dialogueText: “As you wish. I will not leave any stones unturned.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I will do the best I can.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I will do the best I can.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“As they have quite a majority in t..."
entries.dialogueText: “As they have quite a majority in the Assembly, you should.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Hopefully the number of conservati..."
entries.dialogueText: “Hopefully the number of conservatives who will be against us because of this decision will be low.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“If you will excuse me, I have to g..."
entries.dialogueText: “If you will excuse me, I have to get to work immediately. There is much to be done.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian packed up his bag and starte..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian packed up his bag and started making his way to the entrance.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“That will be it for today then.”"
entries.dialogueText: “That will be it for today then.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Thank you all for coming.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you all for coming.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“I know everyone has very busy sche..."
entries.dialogueText: “I know everyone has very busy schedules.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“I've had my fair share of experien..."
entries.dialogueText: “I've had my fair share of experience. I understand when the cards are stacked against me.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“I want to assure you, you will fin..."
entries.dialogueText: “I want to assure you, you will find an ally in me.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I don't need an ally like you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I don't need an ally like you.”
entries.menuText: “I don't need an ally like you.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Sounds wonderful. I am looking for..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sounds wonderful. I am looking forward to working with you.”
entries.menuText: “Sounds wonderful. I am looking forward to working with you.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It had better be that way, Edith...."
entries.dialogueText: “It had better be that way, Edith. For your own good.”
entries.menuText: “It had better be that way, Edith. For your own good.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“I understand.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I understand.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“That's great to hear!”"
entries.dialogueText: “That's great to hear!”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“As you wish. Suit yourself.”"
entries.dialogueText: “As you wish. Suit yourself.”

entries.speaker: Edith Agnoc
entries.title: Edith Agnoc: "“I must leave now as well.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I must leave now as well.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Edith leaned forward to get closer..."
entries.dialogueText: Edith leaned forward to get closer to my ear.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I put the documents in my suitcase..."
entries.dialogueText: I put the documents in my suitcase and left the room with Lucian.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good work, everyone.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good work, everyone.”
entries.menuText: “Good work everyone.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you, Symon.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you, Symon.”
entries.menuText: “Thank you, Symon.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I want to see the results as soon..."
entries.dialogueText: “I want to see the results as soon as possible.”
entries.menuText: “I want to see the results as soon as possible.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“My pleasure.”"
entries.dialogueText: “My pleasure.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Indeed.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Indeed.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Of course. As fast as we can.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Of course. As fast as we can.”
